interval_rule: For each piecewise-cubic trajectory interval, recursively bound relative center speed and endpoint signed distance; certify safe only when the Lipschitz lower bound is strictly positive, certify violation on an exact sampled nonpositive distance, otherwise return unknown.
required_pair_coverage: independently derive every checked scene pair over every complete source move interval at maximum 1 ms subintervals; caller-declared coverage is ignored
empty_coverage_rule: never verified; unknown(NO_GEOMETRY_RELEVANT_MOVE_INTERVALS) only after the producer executes and independently proves that the complete trace contains no move interval; the total oracle may waive only this exact geometry obligation for a no-move trace
